verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents several official integration paths. Agent Skills include pre-built and custom skills, and official client SDKs cover seven languages with streaming, retries and error handling. There is also a managed agent harness, an MCP connector, and Claude Code as a first-party coding agent, which community users report using heavily. Missing for 10: no evidence of official integrations with third-party agent frameworks or third-party coding agents, no plugin mechanism documented, and no dedicated agent-building SDK beyond the general Messages API clients.
